Recommended. Disable only on a trusted device.

Other apps on this device that can reach the loopback port may access the open project through enabled MCP tools. The server stays local; file-write permission and execution approvals remain separate. Continue only on a trusted device.

Network and delegated agents can send project/skill/memory content off-device and incur configured model/API charges. Planning and memory writes, including global memory shared with AI chats, need confirmation too. MCP has separate planning and no AI chat history. Review the full project path and arguments below. Allow only this request. Execution is not a filesystem sandbox; shell commands may use app/Shizuku access, and IDE builds may install or launch apps. Leaving this screen, changing project or waiting 45 seconds cancels pending approval. Already accepted jobs are not rolled back.
